- primal.net: 50/100

Best so far: snort.social at 75/100.

What's your site's score?
https://snap.michaelcli.com/audit.html?demo=1

#bitcoin #nostr #privacy #freesoftware

If you run a personal site, blog, or project page — quick security check from your terminal:

curl "https://snap.michaelcli.com/api/audit?url=https://YOUR-SITE.com"

Shows 8 SEO checks with pass/fail. Takes 5 seconds. No API key.

Most personal sites score 50-75%. Main issues: missing OG image (link previews look bad), no canonical URL (hurts search ranking), and missing Schema.org (Google doesn't understand your content).

Full web version with security headers + broken links: https://snap.michaelcli.com/audit.html?demo=1

Just a solo dev building useful tools. Zap if you find it helpful ⚡
